lead: Long exposure sci-fi film still, deep navy space, cyan light trails, violet nebula glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for spacelancer.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen spacelancer-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish spacelancer-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: sector
images.prompt: A sector of space full of stations, planets, nebula clouds and asteroid fields, linked by lanes of light.

images.name: freelancer
images.prompt: A lone pilot in a flight suit looking out of a cockpit window at a distant space station.

images.name: tether
images.prompt: A glowing beam of light pulling an escape pod away from an exploding starship.

images.name: dogfight
images.prompt: Small starfighters weaving between tumbling asteroids, laser bolts streaking past.

images.name: career
images.prompt: A small cargo starship docking at a busy trading station with bright docking lights.

images.name: hall
images.prompt: A quiet hall of tall statues of pilots under a glass dome full of stars.

images.name: rest
images.prompt: A starship parked in a calm hangar, the cockpit lights dimmed, stars through the open bay doors.

images.name: flight
images.prompt: A starship boosting in a sharp curve, its engine trail bending in a bright arc.

images.name: shields
images.prompt: A rippling energy shield bubble around a starship, sparks where shots hit it.

images.name: heat
images.prompt: Glowing red-hot gun barrels on a starship turret, heat haze rising from them.
